documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Intimation Of Board Meeting Under Regulation 29 Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 ('The Listing Regulations')
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment of ESOP / ESPS

analysis.summary: Gandhar Oil Refinery reported a historic Q1 FY27 with record profitability, driven by agile sourcing, disciplined execution, and favorable product mix amidst challenging Middle East geopolitical conditions. Consolidated revenue grew 92% year-on-year to INR 1,731.9 crores, while EBITDA surged 512% year-on-year to INR 281 crores, and profit after tax rose 688% to INR 206 crores. Management highlighted strong performance in the PHPO and PIO segments alongside a 54% increase in export revenues. The company declared an interim dividend of 100% of the face value of shares and maintains an effectively debt-free standalone balance sheet. Gandhar Oil Refinery (India) Ltd.

guidance.claim: Management targets volume growth in the range of 8% to 10% or up to 11% for the year.
guidance.quote: Historically, we've always been doing volume growth in the range of 8% to 10% to even 11%. So, we see ourselves getting that much of volume growth during this year also.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates export revenue and sales will remain at the same level for coming quarters.
guidance.quote: We anticipate the export revenue and the export sales will be in the same level for the quarters to come.

guidance.claim: Management is hopeful of margins remaining at or around current levels for the whole year.
guidance.quote: We are hopeful of the margins remaining at this level or around this level. The current quarter looks good. And we are hopeful of it carrying forward at these levels for the whole year.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates that margins will continue at stellar levels for at least the next 1 or 2 quarters.
guidance.quote: So obviously, this has been a historical good quarter. But obviously, we anticipate the margins would be continued to be at a stellar levels for at least the next 1 or 2 quarters to come.

demand_outlook.claim: The PIO business grew 28% year-on-year supported by demand from transformer, power, and rubber manufacturers.
demand_outlook.quote: Our PIO business also delivered a robust performance, growing 28% year-on-year, supported by healthy demand from the transformer, power and the rubber manufacturers.

demand_outlook.claim: The lubricant business remained broadly stable, providing a resilient revenue base.
demand_outlook.quote: While the lubricant business remained broadly stable, it continued to provide a resilient revenue base and reinforce strength of our diversified portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth in the PHPO segment was driven by sustained demand from personal care, healthcare, and pharmaceutical sectors.
demand_outlook.quote: The PHPO segment continued to anchor our growth, driven by sustained demand from the personal care, healthcare, and pharmaceutical sectors.

demand_outlook.claim: The PIO business witnessed encouraging traction reflecting healthy demand across transformer, power, and rubber manufacturers.
demand_outlook.quote: The quarter alsowitnessedencouraging traction in the PIO business, reflecting healthy demand acrosstransformer, power & rubber manufacturers.

demand_outlook.claim: The global white oil market is valued at approximately USD1.93 billion in 2026 and is projected to reach USD2.75 billion by 2033 at a CAGR of almost 5.5%.
demand_outlook.quote: Industry estimates suggest that market valued at approximately USD1.93 billion in 2026 is expected to reach close to $2.75 billion by 2033, implying a CAGR of almost 5.5%.

demand_outlook.claim: Asia Pacific leads demand growth, supported by industrial expansion, increasing health care consumption, and rising personal care usage.
demand_outlook.quote: From a geographic perspective, Asia Pacific continues to lead the demand growth supported by industrial expansion, increasing health care consumption and rising personal care usage.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic demand remains stable and robust, particularly in health care and personal care categories.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, domestic demand remains stable, robust, particularly in health care and personal care categories.

capex_expansion.claim: Land is available at all plants for the next phase of expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: Land available at all plants for the next phase

capex_expansion.claim: The land purchased in Taloja is intended for future plant expansion as existing facilities operate near 100% capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: See, the piece of land that has been purchased in Taloja, obviously, will be for plant expansion in Taloja plant. I mean, currently, we are operating at close to 100% of our capacity in our facility, obviously.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue increased by 92% year-on-year to INR 1,731.9 crores and gross margin spread expanded 3.4x year-on-year to INR 28,145 per kilolitre.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, the consolidated revenue increased by 92% year-on-year to INR 1,731.9 crores, while the gross margin spread expanded to 3.4x Y-o-Y basis to INR 28,145 per kilolitre compared to quarter 1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins expanded to 16.20% compared with 5.1% in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins expanded to 16.20% compared with 5.1% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax stood at INR 206 crores, representing a growth of approximately 688% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax stood at INR206 crores compared with INR26 crores in Q1 FY26 and INR37 crores in Q4 FY26, representing a growth of approximately 688% year-on-year and 456% quarter-on-quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin for the quarter on a consolidated level was 21.4%.
Gross margin spread expanded 3.4 times year-on-year to ₹28,145 per kl compared to Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin Spread expanded 3.4x year-on-year to ₹28,145 per kl compared to Q1 FY26

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated gross margins improved from 10.96% in the previous year to 11.48% in FY26, and stood at 12.49% for Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: gross margins have improved from 10.96% to 11.48% on a consolidated basis. For Q4 '26, it was 12.49%.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated finance costs decreased by 28% from INR48.40 crores in FY25 to INR37.59 crores in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Also pertinent to point out that on a consolidated basis, our finance cost has come down from INR48.40 crores in FY25 to INR37.59 crores in FY26. This exhibits an improvement of 28%

margins_costs.claim: R&D expenditure is generally about 4.5% to 5% of total other expenses.
margins_costs.quote: So R&D expenditure is generally about 4.5% to 5% of my total other expenses. And that has been the trend over the years.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin spread for the quarter stood at INR9,351 per kL.
margins_costs.quote: During the quarter, gross margin spread stood at INR9,351 per kL.

orders_capacity.claim: Total sales volume during the quarter stood at approximately 131,000 kilolitres compared with approximately 121,000 kilolitres in Q1 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Total sales volume during the quarter stood at approximately 131,000 kilolitres compared with approximately 121,000 kilolitres in Q1 FY26, reflecting a growth of around 8% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: PIO manufacturing volumes increased from 14,000 to 18,000 KL.
orders_capacity.quote: the PIO manufacturing volumes have gone up from 14,000 to 18,000 KL.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization across all 3 plants taken together is around 97% on a 2-shift basis.
orders_capacity.quote: On a company level, all 3 plants taken together, it's around 97%.

orders_capacity.claim: Volumes for the quarter improved 8% year-on-year to 1,31,449 kl.
orders_capacity.quote: Volumes for the quarter improved 8% year-on-year to 1,31,449 kl

orders_capacity.claim: The Taloja manufacturing facility is operating near 100% utilisation.
Manufacturing volumes for FY26 reached 5,54,212 kL, reflecting an 8% year-on-year growth.
orders_capacity.quote: Manufacturing volumes for FY26 stood at 5,54,212 kL, reflecting a year-on-year growth of 8%, indicating strong operational execution.

orders_capacity.claim: All three manufacturing plants combined operated at 93% capacity utilization, achieving 5,54,212 kL against an installed capacity of 5,97,403 kL.
orders_capacity.quote: All 3 plants taken together, we are working at 93% capacity utilization, which is basically 5,97,403 KL is the capacity installed against which we have achieved 5,54,212 KL which is about 93%.

orders_capacity.claim: Indian plants have an installed capacity of 3,62,100 kL on a 2-shift basis and achieved 4,58,853 kL through additional 3-shift operations.
orders_capacity.quote: So both the Indian plants taken together have an installed capacity of 3,62,100. We have done 4,58, 853. The installed capacity is on a 2-shift basis. And some parts of the year, we have worked on 3-shift basis because of which we have achieved 4,58, 853, which is practically 125% capacity utilization.

capital_allocation.claim: The company declared an interim dividend of 100% of the face value of its shares.
capital_allocation.quote: We are also glad to inform that we have declared an interim dividend of 100% of the face value of our share.

capital_allocation.claim: The company remains effectively debt-free on a standalone basis.
capital_allocation.quote: The company continues to maintain a strong financial position on a stand-alone basis. We remain effectively debt-free, while consolidated borrowings primarily relate to normal trade finance arrangements and borrowings at our overseas subsidiary, Texol.

capital_allocation.claim: INR 20 crores of the performance proceeds will be used for payment of the interim dividend.
capital_allocation.quote: Currently, we have decided to use about INR20 crores of this for payment of interim dividend.

capital_allocation.claim: The company declared an interim dividend of 100% of face value.
capital_allocation.quote: Declared Interim Dividend 100% of Face Value

capital_allocation.claim: Cash flow from operations reached a positive INR127.77 crores as of March 31, 2026, up from INR14.71 crores in the previous year.
capital_allocation.quote: Our cash flow from the operations stood at a positive INR127.77 crores as of 31st March 2026 compared to INR14.71 crores in the previous year, reflecting a stronger operating efficiency and working capital management.

capital_allocation.claim: The board has provided broad approval for an investment amount related to the South Africa business setup.
capital_allocation.quote: We have just taken a broad approval from the Board for investment of the amount that we discussed.

risks_headwinds.claim: Operations at Texol were temporarily impacted by regional supply constraints and disruption in vessel movements due to geopolitical situations.
risks_headwinds.quote: During this period -- during the period of quarter 1, operations were temporarily impacted by regional supply constraints and disruption in vessel movements arising from the geopolitical situation.

risks_headwinds.claim: The operating environment was challenged by heightened Middle East geopolitical tension, Hormuz concerns, and crude oil price volatility.
risks_headwinds.quote: The operating environment remained challenging, shaped by heightened geopolitical tension in the Middle East, concerns surrounding the Strait of Hormuz, volatility in the crude oil and the base oil pricing and intermittent disruptions across the global supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: The operating environment during the quarter remained dynamic, shaped by geopolitical developments in West Asia, crude oil price volatility, and periodic supply chain disruptions.
risks_headwinds.quote: The operating environment during the quarter remained dynamic, shaped by geopolitical developments in West Asia, crude oil price volatility, and periodic supply chain disruptions.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions involving Iran and potential disruptions around the Strait of Hormuz have introduced uncertainty to global energy markets, affecting crude availability, pricing, and freight costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Escalating tensions involving Iran, along with the periodic concern around potential disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz have added uncertainty to the global energy market as one of the world's most critical oil transit choke points and any disruptions in this region has a direct bearing on crude oil availability, pricing and freight cost.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical events caused intermittent volatility in base oil pricing, supply chain tightness, and elevated shipping and insurance costs for Middle East routes.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the period, this resulted in intermittent volatility in the base oil pricing. Some tightness in supply chain and elevated shipping and insurance costs, particularly for routes linked to the Middle East.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Texol plant in the Sharjah Hamriyah Free Zone experienced operational impacts due to port closures restricting vessel movement.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our Texol plant, in the Middle East is , in the Hamriyah Free Zone in Sharjah. So obviously, with the Middle East problems, the Texol plant was impacted a bit, because the port was virtually closed because there was no vessel coming into the port, neither the vessels are able to go out of the port.

management_commitments.claim: Management commits to endeavour to sustain profit margins.
management_commitments.quote: Obviously, the company would do its endeavour or it’s best to ensure to sustain this margin to be very precise.

management_commitments.claim: Management commits that capex plans will be shortly announced next quarter.
management_commitments.quote: our capex plans will be shortly announced. We are drawing up the same, and we'll get back to you on that in the next quarter or so.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to formulate a detailed capacity expansion plan and capex budget for the Taloja facility over the next 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: Having said that, we are working on a detailed plan in terms of what is the capacity expansion plan for the next 2 years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
